any condition that makes it hard for your body to absorb nutrients from food (malabsorption).

kidney disease; or
an electrolyte imbalance.

Ask a doctor before using ergocalciferol if you have allergies, diabetes, or phenylketonuria (PKU).

Your dose needs may be different during pregnancy.
Tell your doctor if you are pregnant or if you become pregnant while taking ergocalciferol.
Ergocalciferol can pass into breast milk.
It may cause side effects in the nursing baby.
Tell your doctor if you are breast-feeding.
